Our Springfield Cleaning Services

Every Budget Heroes home cleaning visit includes the same careful attention, room by room, with a spotless finish you can check before we leave:

  • Standard home cleaning — dusting, vacuuming, mopping, and tidy-up of all living areas
  • Kitchen and bathroom deep cleaning — sinks, counters, tubs, toilets, and appliances
  • Move-in and move-out cleaning — full home preparation for your next chapter
  • Window washing and blind dusting — bright, streak-free glass on every visit
  • Carpet vacuuming and spot treatment — with the right machine for every floor
  • Post-party and event cleanup — fast, thorough, and done before guests return
  • Pet-friendly cleaning — pet hair removal, litter area care, and odor treatment
  • Ongoing weekly and biweekly plans — the same cleaner every visit, on your schedule

Every clean includes a full walkthrough at the start so we know exactly what matters to you, a detailed checklist of everything we will do, and a final review before we leave so nothing is missed.

Cleaning Rates in Springfield

Standard cleaning rates in Springfield start at $119 for a two-bedroom home, with a free same-week estimate and no hidden fees. Deep cleans and move-outs are priced by the home, and every first visit includes a walkthrough with your local team lead before we start any work.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to be home during the clean? No — most customers share a lockbox code or leave a key with their local team, and we text you when we arrive and when we finish.

Do you bring your own supplies? Yes, we bring everything including eco-friendly options on request, so all you need to do is point us at the kitchen.

Do you offer one-time cleans? Absolutely — a one-time clean is the best way to try us, and most first-time customers book their second visit before the first one is done.

Are your cleaners insured? Every single one, and a certificate of insurance is available on request for your records at any time.

How far ahead do I need to book? Most visits are booked two to five days out, and repeat customers get priority scheduling through their local team.

To book your Springfield cleaning, call 503-555-0122 or get in touch through our contact form, and our local team will follow up the same day.
